chapter.heading: Psalm 128
Blessed Is Everyone Who Fears the LORD
A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Blessed is
everyone who,
fears the LORD, who walks in his ways!

You shall
eat the,
fruit of the labor of your hands; you shall be blessed, and it shall be well with you.

Your wife
will be,
like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.

Behold, thus
shall the,
man be blessed who fears the LORD.

The LORD
bless you,
from Zion! May you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life!

May you
see your,
children’s children! Peace be upon Israel! (ESV)
